title: Public Policy and Governance in Public Administration
description: Reviews foundational concepts and the evolution of the fields of public administration, public policy and governance and the proliferation of sub-fields. Introduces theoretical frameworks for analyzing policy-making, policy instruments, networks and communities, policy change and transfer, multilevel governance, critical perspectives and reform. Reviews the challenges and trends confronting governments and society, diverging governance practices across jurisdictions and policy domains. Students conduct research on governance challenges, explore proposed dissertation topics and map the literature.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ADMN 605, POLI 507, POLI 607.
